name: GetSalesOrders
description: Retrieve a list of sales orders from the SAP ERP system. Trigger this function when the user wants to query, filter, search, or view sales orders based on customer ID/name, status, creation date range, sales organization, or quantity limit. All parameters are optional — call immediately when intent is detected.

customerIdOrName.description: Customer ID (e.g. 'CUST-1002', '1000') or partial customer name (e.g. 'Philly Bikes'). Use null or omit if the user does not specify a customer.

fromDate.description: Start date for filtering orders by creation date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Use null or omit if not specified.

toDate.description: End date for filtering orders by creation date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Use null or omit if not specified.

status.description: Filter by order workflow status. Values: Open (đang xử lý/pending), Blocked (bị chặn/hold), PartiallyDelivered (giao một phần/partial), Delivered (đã hoàn thành/completed), Invoiced (đã xuất hóa đơn), Cancelled (đã hủy). Use null or omit if not specified.

salesOrg.description: Sales organization code. Use null or omit if not specified by the user.

top.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–50). Use null or omit if not specified.
